channel.description: Which RISC-V distribution runs on which board, where to get images, and the pitfalls to expect.

item.title: Boards — Milk-V Duo series (Duo / Duo 256M / Duo S)
item.description: Duo: 2× C906 (1GHz + 700MHz) + an 8051, 64MB SIP DRAM; Duo 256M: SG2002 plus 1× Cortex-A53, 256MB; Duo S: 512MB + eMMC pads (some kits ship 8GB) + WiFi6; all have a 100M Ethernet port and USB-C; Duo/256M are 26-pin GPIO pads at 21×51mm, Duo S has 2× 26-pin headers at 43×43mm.
